rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the activity of singing.

example.english: I like singing in my free time.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 si4 zung1 ji3 coeng3 go1

rows.note: Use this more formal noun for singing as a vocal performance or activity.

example.traditional: 今晚嘅歌唱表演好精彩。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 ge3 go1 coeng3 biu2 jin2 hou2 zing1 coi2

rows.note: Use this when referring to the audible singing voice or sound rather than the activity itself.

example.english: Their singing could be heard clearly throughout the auditorium.
example.traditional: 佢嘅歌聲喺成個禮堂都聽得好清楚。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 go1 sing1 hai2 seng4 go3 lai5 tong4 dou1 teng1 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2
